development.questions: Consumed sets only: the 84 paired-source development questions and the 16 paired-source validation questions; 100 questions on 18 packs.
development.allowed: Candidate changes are allowed on development data only.

candidate.description: For a short query with 'test' or 'tests', the first five test hits stay first. The best source hit comes next, then the other test hits, then the other source hits.

validation_rules: compare(B, S1) passes: no aggregate loss of files or visible quotes at 5, 24 or scoped; no net inspection loss; p95 at most max(0.1 s, 1.5 x B).
Zero individual judged-file or visible-quote losses at 5, 24 and scoped.
Judged files at 24: net gain of at least 2, with gains in at least 2 packs.
Every question without a test word has identical delivery on every page; candidate generation is identical for every question.
acceptance.ranking_gate: The CI ranking gate must pass on the PR if the candidate ships.
acceptance.decision: Ship only if every validation rule holds. Validation runs once, for B and S1, with no tuning after it.
